test_title: PYST 7: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held On 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Pointing to a person in an image, Rohit says, "She is the only daughter of the father of my brother's mother." How is the person in the image related to Rohit?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Given: Rohit says, "She is the only daughter of the father of my brother's mother."

Father of Rohit’s brother’s mother = Rohit’s maternal grandfather

Only daughter of Rohit’s maternal grandfather = Rohit’s mother

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/043888433cd34444c9d0d6902514d7bddd3a8c7028d4fe87c03e6f14ac102770.png] 

Hence, the person in the image is Rohit’s mother.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
